notes: Repo's documented USAGE sample (data workx.zipcode; set sashelp.zipcode; run;) that invokes the xls viewer hotkey. sashelp.zipcode is not on Jenner, so a same-shape zipcode dataset (ZIP/Y/X/CITY/STATE/STATECODE) is built inline in autoexec; workx (autoexec-assigned permanent lib upstream) mapped to WORK. Script copies the dataset then inspects it via PROC PRINT + PROC MEANS the way the viewer would let you QC it in Excel.
